acceptance.given: An infrastructure-failure false-negative condition is presented to the detached Probe evaluator.

oracle.expected: The Probe outcome is failed and records the infrastructure-failure false-negative condition.
forbidden: The Probe passes or reports success for the infrastructure-failure false negative.
oracle.observable: Probe result status and diagnostic category emitted by the real independent-process evaluation.

acceptance.then: The evaluator reports a failed Probe outcome for the infrastructure-failure false negative.
acceptance.when: The detached Probe process executes with bound inputs and outputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S10 real Probe evaluation test with an infrastructure-failure false-negative input and require a failed Probe outcome.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure detached Probe evaluation reports infrastructure-failure false negatives as failed outcomes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Probe result categories and bound-input/output contracts.

slice_hint.state_transition: Infrastructure-failure false negative transitions from presented-for-evaluation to failed Probe result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S10 test observes a failed Probe result with the infrastructure-failure diagnostic and no success status.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is evaluated using copied matrix evidence.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and acceptance is refused.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite copied matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate verdict and acceptance decision produced by the matrix-evidence evaluation.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalidated and cannot be accepted.
acceptance.when: The S7 matrix-evidence evaluation detects that evidence was copied.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 aggregate evaluation test with copied matrix evidence and require aggregate invalidation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate matrix aggregates when copied evidence is detected and prevent acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate verdict categories while rejecting copied evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate transitions from evaluated-with-copied-evidence to invalid and non-acceptable.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test observes an invalid aggregate verdict and a refused acceptance decision.

acceptance.given: A foreign-authority case is presented for success evaluation.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success result and success is rejected.
forbidden: Success is accepted for the foreign-authority case.
oracle.observable: Replay or evaluation verdict for the foreign-authority case.

acceptance.then: The evaluator rejects success for the foreign-authority case.
acceptance.when: The S7 adversarial evaluation processes the foreign-authority input.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 foreign-authority adversarial case and require a non-success verdict.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject success for cases whose authority is foreign to the bound evaluation context.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve adversarial verdict categories and authority-binding semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority case transitions from presented-for-success to rejected non-success verdict.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test observes a non-success result and no accepted success for the foreign-authority case.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded but independent Consumer verification has not yet been established.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result records an independent verification of its Consumer.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result exists without an independent Consumer verification record.
oracle.observable: Replay Result evidence fields showing an independently produced Consumer verification bound to the result.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result includes independent Consumer verification evidence.
acceptance.when: The S7 replay-result verification test completes its Consumer check.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S7 successful Replay Result test with Consumer verification omitted or non-independent and require the runtime marker to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require every successful Replay Result to carry independently verified Consumer evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve successful Replay Result schema while adding or enforcing independent Consumer evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay Result transitions from success without independent Consumer verification to success with independently verified Consumer evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 test observes a successful Replay Result containing an independent Consumer verification record.
